entries.title: Vela Maps
entries.note: The app itself, including the SwiftUI screens and the shared Kotlin framework. Source code and the full license text are in the repository.

entries.title: MapLibre Native 6.31.0
entries.note: Vector map renderer, gestures, tile loading and the raster layer support used for traffic and satellite.

entries.title: SWCompression 4.9.1
entries.note: Pure Swift bzip2 and tar reader used to unpack the downloadable Piper voices.

entries.title: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8
entries.note: On-device neural speech runtime. It is linked as a static xcframework and runs the Piper voices and the speech recognition models. The framework carries ONNX Runtime, which is MIT licensed.

entries.title: Kotlin standard library 2.4.20
entries.note: The shared Kotlin code and its standard library are linked into the app binary.

entries.title: kotlinx libraries
entries.note: Coroutines 1.11.0, serialization 1.11.0, datetime 0.8.0 and atomicfu 0.33.0, all statically linked through the shared framework.

entries.title: AndroidX SQLite 2.7.1
entries.note: SQLite compiled into the shared framework for downloaded places, addresses and recorded trips. The AndroidX wrapper is Apache-2.0; SQLite itself is public domain.

entries.title: SKIE 0.10.15
entries.note: Compiler plugin and runtime that let Swift call the Kotlin flows and suspend functions.

entries.title: OpenStreetMap
entries.note: Streets, names, house numbers, places, road markings, cameras, signals and the community DeFlock camera data. Data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors.

entries.title: OpenFreeMap
entries.note: Online vector tiles, glyphs and sprites built from OpenStreetMap. Attribution: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles, OpenStreetMap contributors.

entries.title: OpenMapTiles and the Liberty style
entries.license: BSD and CC-BY schema, ODbL data
entries.note: The vector tile schema and the Liberty style base that the six bundled Vela looks are generated from. The glyphs are served by OpenFreeMap.

entries.title: Esri World Imagery
entries.note: The satellite basemap below zoom 19. Required attribution: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics.

entries.title: Google Maps
entries.note: Place pages, reviews, photos, opening hours, popular times, driving and walking routes, live traffic, Street View and deep satellite imagery. Vela uses Google's public logged-out pages, with no account and no API key.

entries.title: Transitous
entries.license: Per-feed transit data licenses, ODbL for OpenStreetMap data
entries.note: Departures, lines and public transport journeys. Transitous is a community-run service that combines GTFS feeds from transit operators, each under its own license, plus OpenStreetMap data.

entries.title: Photon by komoot
entries.note: Address and place search, including every online search when Vela runs without Google.

entries.title: Overpass API
entries.note: Speed cameras, license plate reader cameras, traffic signals, stop signs, level crossings and speed humps read from OpenStreetMap.

entries.title: Nominatim
entries.note: Reverse geocoding for a long press on the map when Google is not used.

entries.title: OSRM
entries.note: The open router that answers driving and walking routes before any Google fallback.

entries.title: Valhalla
entries.note: The open router used for bicycle routes and alternative driving routes.

entries.title: NDW open road data
entries.note: Dutch bridge openings, read only when the map or a route enters the Netherlands. Nationaal Dataportaal Wegverkeer.

entries.title: UK Fuel Finder
entries.note: UK fuel prices from the government Fuel Finder, republished by matthewgall/fuelfinder-archive. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government License v3.0.

entries.title: Piper voices
entries.note: Downloadable neural voices, published by the sherpa-onnx project as vits-piper archives. Each voice carries its own model card and license. No voice model is bundled; the app downloads the one the user picks.

entries.title: Whisper speech models
entries.note: Optional on-device speech recognition models, downloaded on demand from Vela's release assets. The iPhone's own speech recognizer is the fallback.

entries.title: Wikipedia place names
entries.note: About 3,500 English place-name pronunciations, from English Wikipedia and its contributors, shipped as the en_dict used by English Piper voices.

entries.title: Geofabrik region polygons
entries.note: The download region boundaries shipped in the app, cut from OpenStreetMap extracts.

entries.title: Painted road markings
entries.note: An optional PMTiles pack of painted lane markings, derived from OpenStreetMap and downloaded on demand.

entries.title: Wikidata
entries.note: Population, opening date, official website, coordinates and identifiers for the place sheet's Learn more section and the Wikivoyage layer. Wikidata is CC0 1.0; attribution: Wikidata, CC0 1.0, https://www.wikidata.org

entries.title: Wikivoyage
entries.note: Travel article extracts and geolocated article titles. Attribution: Wikivoyage contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. The extract is shared under the same license, so any reuse keeps this attribution. api.wikimedia.org is the Wikimedia Core REST API.
